name: Stella Architect / iThink
description: Visual system dynamics modelling environments developed by isee systems; Stella Architect targets researchers and educators while iThink is the business-oriented variant. Both use stock-and-flow diagrams to model feedback systems and support interactive simulations with sliders and graphs for policy exploration.
reputation: Long-established system dynamics tools widely used in management education and environmental policy; pioneered visual SD modelling.
notes: Commercial software with educational licensing; Stella Online provides a browser-based version. Model results are deterministic but dependent on structural assumptions.
